hypotheses.construction_plan: Instantiate T(x) at x=p and x=q; the original expression is the sum of the two instantiations.
required_assumptions: V and G0 are single-argument functions
p and q are free symbols over which substitution is well-defined
hypotheses.rationale: The two summands are structurally identical up to the free symbol p versus q, so a single univariate template T(x) specializes to both; no deeper object is required.
